name: Classic Duels
desc:
⚔️ Play Classic Duels for fun solo or team duels in Murderers vs Sheriffs, Obby Races, and Sword Fights!

🎯 Win matches, earn coins, and climb the Leaderboards!
🔫 Collect Skins for your Knive, Gun and Sword to show off your Skins.

❤️ Like and favorite to support the game and for future updates!
⚠️ Exploiting or Farming Stats will get you permanently banned.
